title: How a consumer group rebalances
question: What happens to the partitions of a group when a consumer joins or leaves?

questions.answer: A member joins, leaves, or misses its heartbeat.
The group leader decides the split, and the coordinator sends it out.

questions.text: What does a consumer do during the pause?
questions.answer: It stops work and waits for its new partitions.

chapters.title: The members
chapters.question: Who is in a group?
chapters.picture: Three consumers as yellow boxes on the left. Six partitions as a column on the right.
chapters.ends_with: Each consumer owns two partitions, drawn as lines.

chapters.title: The trigger
chapters.question: What makes the group change?
chapters.picture: The same boxes. One consumer box turns grey.
chapters.ends_with: The grey box leaves the group.

chapters.title: The new split
chapters.question: Who decides the new split?
chapters.picture: Two consumer boxes and six partitions. A crown sits on one box.
chapters.ends_with: Each of the two boxes owns three partitions.

chapters.title: The pause
chapters.question: What does a consumer do while it waits?
chapters.picture: All lines are gone. The boxes wait.
chapters.ends_with: New lines join the boxes to their partitions.
